name: Devin Outposts
desc: Devin sessions running on machines inside your own network.
desc_zh: 跑在你自己网络内机器上的 Devin 会话。
solves: Some code cannot leave the building, so those repositories never got an agent; the session runs on your hardware with the same Devin workflow.
solves_zh: 有些代码不能离开内网，这些仓库一直用不上智能体；会话在你的机器上跑，流程和 Devin 一样。
best_for: Compliance says the repo stays on-prem but the team still wants agent pull requests.
best_for_zh: 合规要求仓库不出内网，但团队依然想要智能体提的 Pull Request。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — devin.ai/blog directory）。 Deployment option for Devin rather than a separate product; recorded because users reach it as its own entry point with its own docs. 首次公开日期来源：https://devin.ai/blog/introducing-devin-outposts
